resources.string: Type text to translate, or help
No app to pick images with

"Qwen Translate · terminal
Type text and press Enter to translate it; type help for commands.
The model runs on this device and works offline once downloaded.
"

"Type any text: translate it (Chinese → English, other languages → Chinese)
translate [options] [text]: the full command line, e.g.
 translate --to ja hello
 translate --fast "quick test" (0.8B fast model)
 translate --quality … (4B high-quality model)
 translate --image PATH (translate the text in an image)
 translate --help (all options)
export NAME=VALUE …: set environment variables, e.g. TRANSLATE_TO=ja or QWEN_TRANSLATE_MODEL=fast
unset NAME … / env: remove / list them
models / models rm FILE: list / delete downloaded models
clear: clear the screen; exit: close
Keys: ^C stops the running command, ↑ ↓ browse the history, IMAGE picks a picture to translate, COPY copies the last translation; pinch to zoom.
In other apps: select text and choose Qwen Translate, or share text or an image to this app.
Models download on first use: 2B (default) 1.3 GB, --fast 0.5 GB, --quality 2.7 GB; images need another 0.2–0.7 GB. They are kept until the app is uninstalled.
"
